definitions.supplemental: O. H. Ger. ge-zal agilis, rapidus, alacer.

quotations.old_english: Wǽron hyra tungan getale teónan gehwylcre and to yfele gehwám ungemet scearpe
quotations.english: their tongues were swift to every wrong and to every evil exceeding sharp

source_text: ge-tal; adj. Quick, ready, active; agilis, velox, expeditus :-- Wǽron hyra tungan getale teónan gehwylcre and to yfele gehwám ungemet scearpe their tongues were swift to every wrong and to every evil exceeding sharp; lingua eorum machæra acuta, Ps. Th. 56, 5. [O. H. Ger. ge-zal agilis, rapidus, alacer.]
